cases.feedback: The current Memory Plugin cannot recall a value if the request changes only the letter casing of an existing key. Improve recall so a differently cased key works only when it maps to a single stored key; preserve exact-match behavior and the khaos-memory-v1 state.

Memory recall fails when a request uses Unicode compatibility characters, such as full-width PROJECT_CODENAME for stored project_codename. Add a narrowly scoped fallback that normalizes NFKC plus case folding and succeeds only for one matching stored key; leave ambiguous matches unfound.
